_meta.description: RxGator centralized data source registry. All sources referenced by server.js, health-check, and documentation.

costPlusDrugs.name: Cost Plus Drugs
costPlusDrugs.description: Mark Cuban's transparent-pricing mail-order pharmacy. Price = cost + 15% markup + $5 pharmacy + $5 shipping.
costPlusDrugs.notes: Mail-order only. Returns unit price; we calculate 30/90-day pricing.

nadac.name: NADAC Benchmark
nadac.description: National Average Drug Acquisition Cost — what pharmacies pay on average. Retail price will be higher.
nadac.notes: 2025 dataset ID: f38d0706-1239-442c-a3cc-40ef1b686ac0. Check annually for new dataset.

openFDA.name: openFDA (Drug Normalization)
openFDA.description: FDA National Drug Code directory — drug identification, dosage forms, manufacturers.
openFDA.notes: Used for drug normalization and Costco price estimation. Not a pricing source itself.

rxNorm.name: RxNorm (NLM)
rxNorm.description: National Library of Medicine drug normalization — resolves brand names to generics, provides RxCUI identifiers.
rxNorm.notes: Free, no API key. Powers brand→generic resolution and fuzzy drug lookup.

medlinePlus.name: MedlinePlus (NLM)
medlinePlus.description: Consumer drug information — plain-language descriptions, side effects, usage instructions.
medlinePlus.notes: Requires RxCUI from RxNorm. Returns drug monographs and related health topics.

medicarePartD.name: Medicare Part D (CMS)
medicarePartD.description: Medicare Part D spending data — total spending, beneficiary count, average cost per claim.
medicarePartD.notes: Dataset ID: 7e0b4365-fd63-4a29-8f5e-e0ac9f66a81b. Check for new annual releases.

fdaDrugShortages.name: FDA Drug Shortages
fdaDrugShortages.description: FDA drug shortage database — alerts when drugs have current supply issues.
fdaDrugShortages.notes: May return 404 (no results) — that's normal (means no shortage). Check for status 'Current' or 'Ongoing'.

singleCare.name: SingleCare
singleCare.description: SingleCare coupon prices — show the coupon at pharmacy counter for discount.
singleCare.notes: Cache loaded at startup. Includes pharmacy-level pricing and price history.

goodRx.name: GoodRx
goodRx.description: GoodRx coupon prices — show the coupon at pharmacy counter for discount.
goodRx.notes: Cache loaded at startup. Filters out mail-order pharmacies for main result.

medicaidFUL.name: Medicaid Federal Upper Limit
medicaidFUL.description: Federal Upper Limit — maximum Medicaid reimbursement for generic drugs. Published monthly by CMS.
medicaidFUL.notes: Includes WAMP (Weighted Average of Manufacturer Prices). Cache updated via update_ful.sh.

manufacturerAssistance.name: Manufacturer Assistance Programs
manufacturerAssistance.description: Patient assistance programs offered directly by drug manufacturers — copay cards, free medication programs.
manufacturerAssistance.notes: Includes brand names, eligibility criteria, enrollment links.

walmart.name: Walmart Rx Program
walmart.description: Walmart $4/$10/$15 generic drug program — in-store pickup, no membership or coupon needed.
walmart.notes: Three tiers: $4/$10 (30/90-day), $9/$24, $15/$38. Hardcoded in server.js as WALMART_4_LIST.

amazonRxPass.name: Amazon RxPass
amazonRxPass.description: Amazon Prime subscription: $5/month covers 55+ generic drugs. Mail-order delivery.
amazonRxPass.dataFreshness: Curated from Amazon's published drug list
amazonRxPass.notes: Requires Amazon Prime ($139/year). $5/month covers ALL eligible generics, not per drug. Not available in all states.

costcoEstimate.name: Costco Pharmacy (Estimated)
costcoEstimate.description: Estimated Costco pharmacy prices based on published reporting. No membership required by federal law.
costcoEstimate.notes: Uses NADAC benchmark with markup formula. No Costco membership needed for pharmacy (federal law).

rxOutreach.name: Rx Outreach
rxOutreach.description: Nonprofit mail-order pharmacy — free shipping, no insurance required. Income-based eligibility.
rxOutreach.notes: Nonprofit. Prices are typically very low. Requires proof of income eligibility.

vaFss.name: VA Federal Supply Schedule
vaFss.description: Federal government negotiated prices — benchmark only, not available to consumers.
vaFss.notes: Shows what the federal government pays. Useful as a 'floor' comparison.

iraNegotiated.name: Medicare Negotiated (IRA)
iraNegotiated.description: Maximum Fair Price under the Inflation Reduction Act — Medicare Part D negotiated prices.
iraNegotiated.dataFreshness: Published by CMS — first batch of 10 drugs (2026 prices)
iraNegotiated.notes: First 10 drugs negotiated under IRA. More drugs expected in future years.

texasWac.name: Texas DSHS (WAC)
texasWac.description: Wholesale Acquisition Cost — manufacturer list price before any discounts. Published by Texas DSHS.
texasWac.notes: WAC is the 'sticker price' — actual prices are almost always lower after discounts and rebates.

rxSaver.name: RxSaver
rxSaver.description: RxSaver prescription discount prices — coupon-based savings at local pharmacies.
rxSaver.notes: Operated by RetailMeNot/Ziff Davis. Includes pharmacy-level pricing.

blinkHealth.name: Blink Health
blinkHealth.description: Blink Health / BlinkRx discount prices — pay online, pick up at pharmacy or get delivery.
blinkHealth.notes: Pay online for a discounted price, then pick up at local pharmacy or get home delivery.
